definitions: A district in Paris, France, known for its gardens and views of the Eiffel Tower.
A former palace in Paris, France, built for the 1878 Universal Exhibition, replaced by the Palais de Chaillot.
A station on the Paris Métro.
examples: We walked through the Trocadéro gardens.
The view of the Eiffel Tower from the Trocadéro is iconic.
Take the Métro to Trocadéro station.
